title: Disability Radio Talk Show

images.alt: Disability Radio Talk Show guests live at Radio Veritas 102.9FM

subline: A weekly live radio show on Radio Veritas 102.9FM giving persons with disabilities a platform to challenge stereotypes.
description: A weekly live radio program on Radio Veritas 102.9FM, airing every Saturday from 4–5pm, giving persons with disabilities a platform to share their stories and challenge stereotypes. Episodes have covered sickle cell awareness, autism, deaf inclusion, inclusive education, and workplace inclusion, featuring guests with disabilities and partner organizations.
impacts: Weekly live audience across The Gambia via Radio Veritas 102.9FM and the online stream.
Running every Saturday since at least 2022, featuring guests with disabilities and partner organizations.

title: Rolls & Walks 2.0
subline: A Gambia-wide disability inclusion walk bringing together 400+ students and 100+ adults from 26+ schools.
description: In partnership with the Remembering Reuel Foundation, Rolls & Walks 2.0 (7 July 2026) is a disability awareness and inclusion event under the theme "Everyone Has a Way," aiming to bring together over 400 students and 100 adults from more than 26 schools across The Gambia to learn, interact, and celebrate inclusion.
impacts: Fundraising target: GMD 300,000+ for transportation, meals, and participation costs.
GMD 10,000 makes you a partner Inclusion Champion.

title: Disability Rights Initiative Project (DRIP)

images.alt: BethGold Foundation advocacy meeting with the Mayor of Kanifing Municipal Council
BethGold Foundation advocacy meeting with the Mayor of Kanifing Municipal Council

subline: A flagship advocacy programme promoting and protecting the rights of persons with disabilities.
description: A flagship advocacy programme dedicated to promoting and protecting the rights of persons with disabilities. DRIP works with government institutions, civil society, the private sector, and communities to advance disability-inclusive policies, strengthen the implementation of disability laws, and create an inclusive society where everyone can participate equally.
impacts: Engaged the Kanifing Municipal Council in a formal partnership advancing disability-inclusive treatment and education (November 2023).

subline: A nationwide awareness campaign challenging stigma and promoting equal opportunities for persons with disabilities.
description: A nationwide awareness and advocacy campaign that challenges stigma, promotes accessibility, and fosters equal opportunities for persons with disabilities through public education, community engagement, and strategic partnerships.
